steel.name: Steel Elite
steel.description: Takes massively reduced damage from projectiles.

time_fractured.name: Time Fractured
time_fractured.description: Freezes all workers in the city while alive.

summoner.name: Summoner Elite
summoner.description: Summons copies of themselves every few seconds.

mending.name: Mending Elite
mending.description: Heals all allies nearby them periodically

unstoppable.name: Unstoppable Elite
unstoppable.description: Cannot be slowed or stunned, gains massive health increase

enemies.name: Basic Square
enemies.description: Basic enemy that on their own isnt much of a threat, but hundreds together can get difficult.

enemies.name: Speedy Triangle
enemies.description: A fast triangle with high speed, can really pick at your defenses if you dont have good burst damage.

enemies.name: Tanky Rectangle
enemies.description: Super slow but crazy high health, will make room for their allies to break through.

enemies.name: Shooty Diamond
enemies.description: Extremely deadly, targets one turret at a time and stops to fire projectiles at it till it's destroyed.

enemies.name: Hexagonal Mothership
enemies.description: One of the sacred bosses of the universe, super slow but will summon her childeren every couple seconds.

enemies.name: Packed Circle
enemies.description: Explodes when it dies into mini explosive circles that rush at your defenses. You might need some splash damage.

enemies.name: Mini Packed Circle
enemies.description: Rushes at turrets to explode, very low health and usually comes from Packed Circles.
